text:
"""P11, ONE change against the best known round 1 (three accepted claim kinds, no attachment, no alternative):
take up Kalwisz's own request (e-mail of 10 July: pay within 10 days against a cash discount). Hollerau commits to
pay within 10 days of delivery; the sheet cannot carry it (payment_days is fixed at 60 by the case). Same ladder as
before; accept at agreed / final offer. Decisive: Kalwisz held 45.50 in every earlier run."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import msg, ladder, their_sheet

CASE = "case:P11"
SHEET = {"ppm_commitment": 300, "chargeback_eur_per_complaint": 0}


def move(st):
    r = st["round"]
    last = st["last"]
    if r > 1 and last.get("status") in ("agreed", "final_offer"):
        return {"accept": their_sheet(st)[0]}
    if r == 1:
        body = (
            "Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthank you for your offer and for committing to a much tighter quality level.\n\n"
            "Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to "
            "2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).\n"
            "Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).\n"
            "Our last 4 quality notifications on part:310020 with you (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, "
            "qn:20004747) averaged 17197 ppm.\n\n"
            "In July you asked whether we could pay your invoices within 10 days, against a cash discount. We can: from "
            "January we will pay your invoices for this bracket within 10 days of delivery. In return we ask you to "
            "reflect the discount in the price.\n\n"
            "We propose EUR 43.00 per unit with a 300 ppm commitment, paid within 10 days.\n\n"
            "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
        return msg("Bearing bracket HN - price, quality and 10-day payment", body, [{**SHEET, "unit_price": 43.0}])
    p = ladder(st, 43.0, 0.3)
    body = (f"Dear Mr Lis,\n\nthank you for moving. With payment within 10 days of delivery we can go to EUR {p:.2f} "
            "per unit with the 300 ppm commitment. Is the 10-day payment enough for you to come closer, or what else "
            "would you need?\n\nKind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
    return msg("Re: Bearing bracket HN", body, [{**SHEET, "unit_price": p}])

case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

message.subject: Bearing bracket HN - price, quality and 10-day payment
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

thank you for your offer and for committing to a much tighter quality level.

Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:310020 changed by +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).
Our last 4 quality notifications on part:310020 with you (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, qn:20004747) averaged 17197 ppm.

In July you asked whether we could pay your invoices within 10 days, against a cash discount. We can: from January we will pay your invoices for this bracket within 10 days of delivery. In return we ask you to reflect the discount in the price.

We propose EUR 43.00 per unit with a 300 ppm commitment, paid within 10 days.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
response.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN - price, quality and 10-day payment
response.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

We value our cooperation and have made a step towards you. Our current offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
